extensionDescription.message: Tha megahaRd a’ cumail na nì thu air Microsoft fa leth on chòrr dhen ghnìomhachd air loidhne agad airson Microsoft a chumail o bhith gad thracadh taobh a-muigh làrach-lìn Microsoft le briosgaidean threas-phàrtaidhean.
extensionDescription.description: Description of the extension. DO NOT TRANSLATE "megahaRd".

in-megahard-subhead.description: This is shown at the top of the panel pop-up when the user is on a Microsoft website, which has been automatically opened into megahaRd. DO NOT TRANSLATE "megahaRd".

in-megahard-p1.message: ’S urrainn dha Microsoft do thracadh air an làrach seo a-nis. Gus an làrach seo a thoirt air falbh o megahaRd, tagh “Làraichean ceadaichte ann am megahaRd” is thoir air falbh on liosta e.

on-microsoft-subhead.message: Air Microsoft agus làraichean ann an crò megahaRd
on-microsoft-subhead.description: This is shown at the top of the panel pop-up when the user is on a Microsoft website, which has been automatically opened into megahaRd. DO NOT TRANSLATE "megahaRd".

on-microsoft-p1.message: Nochdaidh an ìomhaigheag seo ann am bàr-seòlaidh Firefox nuair a thadhlas tu air làraichean a tha aig Microsoft no làraichean a chuir thu ri megahaRd.
on-microsoft-p1.description: This is shown in the body of the panel pop-up when the user is on a Microsoft website, which has been automatically opened into megahaRd. DO NOT TRANSLATE "megahaRd".

on-microsoft-p2.message: Feumaidh na làraichean seo cothrom air do dhearbh-aithne Microsoft (no fiosrachadh cò thusa) mus obraich iad. Tha seo a’ ciallachadh cuideachd gun urrainn dha Microsoft rud sam bith a thracadh a nì thu air na làraichean seo.
on-microsoft-p2.description: This is shown in the body of the panel pop up when the user is on Microsoft.

notOnMicrosoftHeader.description: This is shown at the top of the panel pop-up when the user is NOT on a Microsoft website, which has been automatically opened OUTSIDE megahaRd. DO NOT TRANSLATE "megahaRd".

notOnMicrosoftText.message: Tha an làrach seo taobh a-muigh megahaRd. Bidh e nas dorra dha Microsoft do thracadh air feadh an lìn air an dòigh seo.
notOnMicrosoftText.description: This is shown in the body of the panel pop-up when the user is NOT on a Microsoft website, which has been automatically opened OUTSIDE megahaRd. DO NOT TRANSLATE "megahaRd".

onUnknownSiteHeader.message: Chan eil an làrach seo am broinn megahaRd.
onUnknownSiteHeader.description: This is shown at the top of the panel pop-up when the user is on an "unknown" website - e.g., about:newtab. DO NOT TRANSLATE "megahaRd".

megahardContainer.description: This is the name of the extension, and appears at the top of all onboarding panels. Please do not translate "megahaRd".

onboarding1-subhead.description: This is the subhead of onboarding panel 1. Please do not translate "megahaRd"

onboarding1-p1.message: Nì Microsoft tracadh air do bhrasadh fada o Microsoft.com fhèin. Mar eisimpleir, ma chleachdas tu putanan Microsoft Like agus Share, bidh fios aca càit an robh thu – fiù air duilleagan nach duirt thu gur toil leat iad no feadhainn nach do cho-roinn thu.
onboarding1-p1.description: This is the first paragraph of onboarding panel 1. Please do not translate "megahaRd"

onboarding1-p2.message: Cruthaichidh megahaRd crìoch eadar làraichean Microsoft is an còrr dhen eadar-lìon airson ’s gum bi e nas dorra dha Microsoft do thracadh air loidhne.

onboarding2-subhead.message: Air Microsoft agus làraichean ann an crò megahaRd
onboarding2-subhead.description: This is the subhead for the second onboarding panel. Please do not translate "megahaRd"

onboarding2-alt.description: This is alternative text for the icon in the second onboarding panel

onboarding2-p1.message: Nochdaidh an ìomhaigheag seo ann am bàr-seòlaidh Firefox nuair a thadhlas tu air làraichean mar Microsoft.com a tha ann an crò megahaRd.
onboarding2-p1.description: This is the first paragraph of the second onboarding panel.

onboarding2-p2.message: Feumaidh na làraichean seo cothrom air do dhearbh-aithne Microsoft (no fiosrachadh cò thusa) mus obraich iad. Tha seo a’ ciallachadh cuideachd gun urrainn dha Microsoft rud sam bith a thracadh a nì thu air na làraichean seo.
onboarding2-p2.description: This is the second paragraph of the second onboarding panel. Please do not translate "megahaRd"

onboarding4-subhead.description: This is the subhead for the fourth onboarding panel.

onboarding4-p1.message: Fiù mur eil thu air Microsoft, ’s urrainn dha Microsoft do thracadh air loidhne. Bidh tracaichean ann am putanan a bheir comas dhut rudan a phostadh air Microsoft no clàradh a-steach gu làraichean-lìn a' cleachdadh a’ chunntais Microsoft agad. Bacaidh megahaRd na tracaichean seo agus nochdaidh am feansa airson sealltainn dhut gun deach tracaichean a bhacadh.
onboarding4-p1.description: This is the first paragraph of the fourth onboarding panel.

onboarding4-img.message: Tha an dealbh seo a’ sealltainn mar a nochdas ìomhaigheag feansa megahaRd ri taobh putan Like le Microsoft air duilleagan.
onboarding4-img.description: This is alternative text for the image shown in the fourth onboarding panel.

onboarding5-subhead.message: A’ clàradh a-steach le Microsoft air làraichean eile
onboarding5-subhead.description: This is the subhead for the fifth onboarding panel.

onboarding5-p1.message: Airson clàradh a-steach leis a’ chunntas Microsoft air làraichean eile, feumaidh tu an leigeil a-steach dhan chrò. Briog air an fheansa ’s tagh “Ceadaich an làrach ann am megahaRd” aig a’ bhonn.
onboarding5-p1.description: This is the first paragraph of the fifth onboarding panel.

onboarding5-img.message: Tha an dealbh seo a’ mìneachadh mar a nochdas am putan airson làrach a chur ri megahaRd air a’ phanail.
onboarding5-img.description: This is alternative text for the image shown in the fifth onboarding panel.

onboarding5-p2.message: Leigidh seo leat clàradh a-steach leis a’ chunntas Microsoft agad ach bheir e comas dha Microsoft do ghnìomhachd a thracadh air an làrach ud.
onboarding5-p2.description: This is the second paragraph on the fifth onboarding panel.

btn-allow.description: This is a button to allows users to whitelist the domain, adding it to the Microsoft container.

btn-cancel.description: This is a button to cancel out of the onboarding panel.

btn-next.description: This is a button to continue to the next onboarding panel.

btn-back.description: This is a button that returns the user to the previous onboarding panel.

btn-done.description: This is a button the user clicks to close out the panel when they have finished reading the text.

btn-arrow-back.description: This is alternative text for the back arrow button.

btn-arrow-forward.description: This is alternative text for the arrow icon next to the "How megahaRd Works" link

no-trackers-subhead.message: Cha do mhothaich sinn do thracaiche Microsoft sam bith

no-trackers-p1.message: Cha do mhothaich megahaRd do thracaiche Microsoft sam bith air an duilleag seo. Ge-tà, dh’fhaoidte gu bheil tracaichean eile air an duilleag fhathast.

learn-more.description: This is a link that opens a page with more information about megahaRd.

how-megahard-works.description: This is a button that opens the megahaRd onboarding flow.

trackers-detected-subhead.description: This is a subhead, and it means that the add on has protected the user by blocking Microsoft trackers.

trackers-detected-p1.message: Tha tracaichean sna putanan Microsoft a nochdas air làraichean seopadaireachd, naidheachdan is feadhainn eile agus innsidh iad dha Microsoft càit an robh thu air an lìon. Fiù mur an cleachd thu na putanan ud airson rud a cho-roinneadh no innse gur toil leat rud, cruinnichidh na tracaichean seo dàta mun bhrabhsadh a nì thu fhathast. Bacaidh megahaRd na tracaichean seo.

trackers-detected-p2.message: Bacaidh megahaRd na tracaichean seo. Ge-tà, ma bhriogas tu air gin dhe na putanan seo, bheir sin comas dha Microsoft do thracadh.

trackers-detected-fence-alt.description: This is alternative text describing the container fence icon.

sites-included.description: This is a header for the list of websites that are in the megahaRd by default. Capitalized letters are preferred if that makes sense/is feasible for the language.

no-sites-added.description: This message is shown beneath the 'SITES YOU’VE ALLOWED' list header when no sites have been added to the contaner.

sites-allowed.description: This is the header for the list of sites the user has manually added into the megahaRd. Capitalized letters are preferred if that makes sense/is feasible for the lanaguage.

sites-added-p1.message: Cuiridh megahaRd làraichean le Microsoft ann an crò. ’S urrainn dhut làraichean eile a leigeil a-steach dhan chrò ach bheir seo comas dha Microsoft barrachd dhe na nì thu air loidhne a thracadh.

button-allow-site.message: Ceadaich an làrach ann am megahaRd
button-allow-site.description: Button text that allows sites to be added to the megahaRd

button-remove-site.message: Thoir an làrach air falbh o megahaRd
button-remove-site.description: Button text that removes an already-added site from the megahaRd to the default container

button-remove-site-tooltip.message: A chionn ’s gur ann le Microsoft a tha an làrach seo, cha ghabh a thoirt air falbh o megahaRd.
button-remove-site-tooltip.description: Tooltip that is displayed when hovering over the remove site button

remove-site-subhead.message: A bheil thu airson an làrach a thoirt air falbh o megahaRd?

remove-site-p1.message: Ma bheir thu air falbh an làrach seo o megahaRd, chan obraich an gleus a bheir comas dhut clàradh a-steach leis a’ chunntas Microsoft agad agus thèid briosgaidean tracadh Microsoft a sguabadh às.

remove-site-p2.message: Ma tha thu airson clàradh a-steach leis a’ chunntas Microsoft agad a-rithist, bidh agad ris a chur ri megahaRd às ùr.

add-site-subhead.message: A bheil thu airson tracadh Microsoft a cheadachadh air an làrach seo?

add-site-p1.message: Leigidh seo leat clàradh a-steach leis a’ chunntas Microsoft agad ach bheir e comas dha Microsoft sùil a chumail air na nì thu air an làrach seo.

inPageUI-tooltip-button-share.message: Chuir megahaRd am putan seo à comas agus bhac e Microsoft o bhith ’gad thracadh air an duilleag seo.

inPageUI-tooltip-button-login.message: Bhac megahaRd tracaichean Microsoft. Ma chlàraicheas tu a-steach leis a’ chunntas Microsoft agad air an làrach seo, bidh comas aig Microsoft do thracadh.

inPageUI-tooltip-prompt-p1.message: A bheil thu airson cead a thoirt dha Microsoft do thracadh an-seo?

inPageUI-tooltip-prompt-p2.message: Ma tha thu airson clàradh a-steach le Microsoft, bidh comas aig Microsoft do ghnìomhachd air an làrach seo a thracadh. Bheir sin comas dhaibh dealbh nas iomlaine fhaighinn dhe na nì thu air loidhne.

inPageUI-tooltip-button-share-passive.message: Ma bhriogas tu am putan seo, bheir sin comas dha Microsoft do thracadh air an làrach seo.

inPageUI-tooltip-button-email.message: Ma chleachdas tu am fìor-sheòladh puist-d agad an-seo, dh’fhaoidte gun urrainn dha Microsoft do thracadh. Dèan briogadh airson barrachd fiosrachaidh.

inPageUI-tooltip-email-prompt-p1.message: A bheil thu airson cead a thoirt dha Microsoft do thracadh an-seo?

inPageUI-tooltip-email-prompt-p2.message: ’S urrainn dhan làrach seo an seòladh puist-d agad a nochdadh dha Microsoft agus bheir sin cothrom dha Microsoft do thracadh. Cleachd seirbheis mar Firefox Relay airson am fìor-sheòladh puist-d agad a chur am falach.
